$description: Tag component color tokens for all tag color variants and states.

tag-background-blue.$description: Background color for blue tags. Use for informational tags or to categorize content with blue semantic meaning.

tag-background-cool-gray.$description: Background color for cool gray tags. Use for neutral categorization or when color semantics are not needed.

tag-background-cyan.$description: Background color for cyan tags. Use for tags related to data, analytics, or technical information.

tag-background-gray.$description: Background color for gray tags. Use for default or neutral tags without specific semantic meaning.

tag-background-green.$description: Background color for green tags. Use for success states, positive indicators, or approved/active status.

tag-background-magenta.$description: Background color for magenta tags. Use for creative, design-related, or special category tags.

tag-background-purple.$description: Background color for purple tags. Use for premium features, special status, or priority indicators.

tag-background-red.$description: Background color for red tags. Use for error states, critical issues, or urgent/high-priority items.

tag-background-teal.$description: Background color for teal tags. Use for tags related to support, help, or secondary informational content.

tag-background-warm-gray.$description: Background color for warm gray tags. Use for neutral categorization with a warmer tone than cool gray.
